# bringupbox

Brings the status box to the top of the Z order. *(version 4.78 or later)*

```ttl
bringupbox
```

## Parameters

## Return Value

## Example

```ttl
step = 0
while 1
  call show_step
  sendln 'echo do something'
  wait '$'
  pause 2

  bringupbox

endwhile
end

:show_step
step = step + 1
gettime timestr "%Y/%m/%d-%H:%M:%S"
sprintf2 s "counter %d" step
statusbox timestr s
return
```
